comment: The boundary worth guarding is against local-ai-app-integration: this skill
makes the *agent* use local models, that one makes the *user's app* do it.
`agent-generates-image-locally` is that line from this side.

expected_matches.prompt: I'm burning way too much money on image generation API calls. Can you make this workspace generate images on my own machine instead?
Stop sending text to a paid cloud TTS service. From now on, I want anything you read aloud synthesized offline on this laptop.
Transcribe meeting.wav for me, and keep the audio on this device instead of uploading it to a transcription service.
From now on, when using Claude, use local models for generating pictures but keep using the cloud for chat.

expected_matches.note: Names a cloud image API and an app-shaped complaint, but the thing going local is the agent, not the user's app.
expected_matches.prompt: Stop calling DALL-E when I ask you for a picture. Generate images on this machine instead so I stop paying per image.

expected_matches.note: Tier 2. The end-to-end case: needs a reachable Lemonade Server, which the default runners provide.
expected_matches.prompt: Learn how to generate images locally, then generate an image of a cat and save it to out.png.
should: Install Lemonade Server if it is not already installed
Download the SD-Turbo model if the model is not already downloaded
Add a 'Local AI Use' block to AGENTS.md
should_not: Pull TTS or STT models for this image generation task
Reach for a cloud image path instead of local Lemonade

expected_no_matches.note: Local, on-device, and model-shaped, but training is nobody's job here.
expected_no_matches.prompt: Fine-tune a small language model on my own dataset using the GPU in my laptop.
Compare the output quality of DALL-E 3 and Midjourney for product photography and tell me which to buy.
